name: Internal Company RAG Golden Dataset
description: Golden evaluation cases for the demo internal-company RAG application. Cases cover project delivery, resources, sales opportunities, accounts, revenue, cross-document reasoning, missing information, and out-of-domain behavior.

cases.input: Who is working on the GraphRAG project and what is their allocation?
cases.expected_output: Alex Martin is working on the GraphRAG Platform project with a 70% allocation.

cases.input: What is the status and actual cost of the GraphRAG project?
cases.expected_output: The GraphRAG Platform project is delayed and has an actual cost of $720,000.

cases.input: How many days is the GraphRAG Platform project delayed?
cases.expected_output: The GraphRAG Platform project is delayed by 35 days.

cases.input: Who is assigned to the Factory AI Insights project and what is their allocation?
cases.expected_output: Emma White is assigned to Factory AI Insights with a 60% allocation.

cases.input: What is the actual cost and delay for the Factory AI Insights project?
cases.expected_output: Factory AI Insights has an actual cost of $620,000 and is delayed by 45 days.

cases.input: Who is working on the Retail Recommendation Engine and what is their allocation?
cases.expected_output: Chris Green is working on the Retail Recommendation Engine with an 80% allocation.

cases.input: Who worked on the Snowflake Platform project and what skill did they provide?
cases.expected_output: Sarah Wilson worked on the Snowflake Platform project, providing Snowflake Engineering skills.

cases.input: Did the Azure Modernization project finish under or over budget, and by how much?
cases.expected_output: Azure Modernization finished $50,000 under budget: the budget was $700,000 and the actual cost was $650,000.

cases.input: Who handled the GraphRAG Platform sales opportunity and what was the deal value?
cases.expected_output: Alice Brown handled the GraphRAG Platform opportunity, which had a deal value of $650,000.

cases.input: Which client had the AWS Data Lake opportunity, what was it worth, and why was it lost?
cases.expected_output: MedCore had the AWS Data Lake opportunity. It was worth $450,000 and was lost because of Proposal Delay.

cases.input: Why was HealthFirst's AWS Migration opportunity lost and what was its value?
cases.expected_output: HealthFirst's AWS Migration opportunity was worth $500,000 and was lost because of an AWS Skill Shortage.

cases.input: What was the value and outcome of FinTrust's Azure Modernization opportunity?
cases.expected_output: FinTrust's Azure Modernization opportunity was worth $700,000 and was won.

cases.input: Who was the sales representative for GlobalBank's Snowflake Platform opportunity?
cases.expected_output: Sarah Lee was the sales representative for GlobalBank's Snowflake Platform opportunity.

cases.input: What service and deal value were associated with RetailMax's Databricks Analytics opportunity?
cases.expected_output: RetailMax's Databricks Analytics opportunity was for AI Analytics and had a deal value of $400,000.

cases.input: What happened to the Healthcare AI Assistant opportunity and why?
cases.expected_output: The Healthcare AI Assistant opportunity was lost because of Resource Unavailability.

cases.input: What was the value of MedCore's Cloud Transformation opportunity and why was it lost?
cases.expected_output: MedCore's Cloud Transformation opportunity was worth $700,000 and was lost because of an AWS Architect Shortage.

cases.input: What was BFSI revenue in Q2 2025?

cases.input: What was Retail revenue in Q2 2025?

cases.input: What was total revenue across all industries in Q2 2025?
cases.expected_output: Total revenue across all industries in Q2 2025 was $4,700,000.

cases.expected_output: BFSI had the highest Q2 2025 revenue at $1,700,000.

cases.expected_output: Healthcare had the largest revenue drop, decreasing by $900,000 from $1,800,000 in Q1 to $900,000 in Q2.

cases.input: Which industries had the largest revenue increase from Q1 to Q2 2025?
cases.expected_output: BFSI and Retail tied for the largest increase, each growing by $200,000 from Q1 to Q2 2025.

cases.expected_output: Yes. The GraphRAG Platform opportunity was won, and the corresponding project is currently delayed.
